## Validation

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes.
- [ ] User-facing documentation is updated when needed.
- [ ] Runtime code keeps the zero-dependency guarantee.
- [ ] Storage and CLI compatibility are preserved, or the impact is documented.
- [ ] No secrets, private traces, or unrelated changes are included.
